faqs.question: Is there any registration fee for DRISHTI 2K26?
faqs.answer: No, registration is completely FREE. Anyone with passion for reel-making and storytelling can participate.

faqs.question: What are the two mandatory reel categories?
faqs.answer: Participants must submit two separate Instagram Reel links: 1) MAIN STORY REEL — an original story connected to Durgi, Navaratri, Kaduru Dasara, local traditions, devotion, or festival emotions; 2) DURGI REEL — a creative reel showcasing Durgi and the festive atmosphere.

faqs.question: Can I participate as a team or group?
faqs.answer: Participation is strictly INDIVIDUAL. Each registration is for one person, and unique registration ID will be issued.

faqs.question: Is there a duration limit for the reels?
faqs.answer: There is no fixed video duration limit. Focus on storytelling, cinematic quality, rhythm, and festival essence.

faqs.question: Are AI-generated audio and visual elements allowed?
faqs.answer: AI-generated audio and visual enhancement elements are permitted, but Durgi's actual idol appearance, face, jewellery, and identity must NEVER be altered or replaced with AI avatars.

faqs.question: How do I submit my Instagram Reel links?
faqs.answer: After completing your free registration, you will receive a unique Registration ID (DR26-XXXXXX) and a secure Submission Access Link. You can submit one video first and update the second video anytime before the deadline (20 October 2026).

faqs.question: Can I use mobile phones or do I need DSLR cameras?
faqs.answer: Mobile phones, DSLRs, mirrorless cameras, and action cameras are all welcome! Creativity and devotion matter most.

faqs.question: Who should I contact if I have questions?
faqs.answer: You can reach out to our coordinators: Gagan (+91 6362320465) or Tarun K (+91 9353903861) via WhatsApp or phone call.
